sehemu: Part III: House of Representatives of Zanzibar
jina: Powers of the House of Representatives
maudhui: (1) The President of Zanzibar, as one part of the House of Representatives, shall exercise all powers conferred upon him for that purpose by this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar. (2) The Representatives, as the House of Representatives, shall be the principal organ in Tanzania Zanzibar having authority, on behalf of the people of Tanzania Zanzibar, to oversee and advise the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and all its organs in the discharge of their responsibilities in accordance with this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar. (3) For the purpose of exercising its powers, the House of Representatives may: (a) ask any Minister of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar any question concerning public affairs in Tanzania Zanzibar within his responsibility; (b) debate the performance of every Ministry of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar during the annual budget meeting of the House of Representatives; (c) debate and approve any long-term or short-term plan intended to be implemented in Tanzania Zanzibar, and enact legislation to regulate implementation of that plan; (d) enact legislation where implementation requires a law; and (e) prepare, or direct the preparation of, and submit to any political party a report concerning any matter within the authority of Parliament.
vifungu: (1) The President of Zanzibar, as one part of the House of Representatives, shall exercise all powers conferred upon him for that purpose by this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar.

(2) The Representatives, as the House of Representatives, shall be the principal organ in Tanzania Zanzibar having authority, on behalf of the people of Tanzania Zanzibar, to oversee and advise the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and all its organs in the discharge of their responsibilities in accordance with this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar.

(3) For the purpose of exercising its powers, the House of Representatives may: (a) ask any Minister of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar any question concerning public affairs in Tanzania Zanzibar within his responsibility; (b) debate the performance of every Ministry of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar during the annual budget meeting of the House of Representatives; (c) debate and approve any long-term or short-term plan intended to be implemented in Tanzania Zanzibar, and enact legislation to regulate implementation of that plan; (d) enact legislation where implementation requires a law; and (e) prepare, or direct the preparation of, and submit to any political party a report concerning any matter within the authority of Parliament.
